title: Bank Staff Facilitating Money Laundering, Says Official
excerpt: A top anti-money laundering official in Pakistan stated that banking staff are functioning as conveyor belts for illegal money transfers.
body_html:
According to the country's top anti-money laundering official, banking staff in Pakistan are functioning as conveyor belts for money laundering activities.

The statement was delivered during a briefing to a Senate committee, highlighting the internal vulnerabilities within the banking sector regarding illicit financial flows.
